dct_title_s: Discoveries of Western Australia : from documents furnished to the Colonial Office by J.S. Roe, Esq., Surv. Genl
dct_description_sm: by permission dedicated to R.W. Hay, Esq., one of H.M. Under Secretaries of State for the Colonies by his obliged servant J. Arrowsmith.
Topographic map of Western Australia showing settlements in the early 1830s. Relief is shown by hachures.
Plate 36 from: London atlas. Vol. 1. London : J. Arrowsmith, 1832-1846.
Insets: Fremantle. Scale [ca. 1:31,680] -- Perth. Scale [ca. 1:31,680] -- Kelmscott. Scale [ca. 1:31,680] -- Augusta. Scale [ca. 1:31,680].
